goal.text: find the soft toy she has been hunting for through the house, and keep a running account of which places have already been checked and left tidy

turns.text: Did I look under the pillows, or only move them?

trigger.detail: the user opens the session herself

expected_answer.text: Yes, you lifted the pillows with your left hand, looked underneath, then put them straight back down in their original position.

turns.text: um, hang on — under, or over?

trigger.detail: the kneeling search by the bed frame ended

expected_answer.text: You knelt on your right knee and looked underneath, so yes, a proper look, not just a lean.

turns.text: So that's both spots in there ruled out, then?

trigger.detail: the user sums up before leaving the room

expected_answer.text: Both of those are done, yes. Nothing was under the pillows and nothing under there either, so we move on.

turns.text: How many did I pull open at that first desk?

trigger.detail: both desk drawers were shut again

expected_answer.text: Two. You pulled one open with your right hand, the second with your left, then shut them both at once.

turns.text: Those weren't the ones I meant. The taller stack beside it, did every one of those open?

trigger.detail: the user narrows her own previous question

expected_answer.text: No. One of them stuck when you tried it with the other hand, so you came back and worked it left-handed.

turns.text: In the fridge I changed my mind — about what?

trigger.detail: gaze left the table and landed on the fridge

expected_answer.text: A purple item from the shelf. You lifted it out with your left hand, then put it straight back and shut the door.

turns.text: mm-hm, mm— actually, that thing I've been carrying since the bedroom, which hand has it been in?

trigger.detail: a backchannel turns into a turn mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Your right. It is the small rugby-shaped stress ball, and it has stayed in that hand from the bedroom all the way here.

turns.text: Did anything get moved off the counter, and where to?

trigger.detail: the counter was cleared and a drawer opened

expected_answer.text: You picked the mirror up off the counter with both hands and leaned it against the window, where it still is.

turns.text: oh, before I forget — one of those drawers next door, I didn't close that by hand, did I?

trigger.detail: the user reopens an earlier thread

expected_answer.text: No, you shut that one with your right foot while your hands were still full.

turns.text: What did I shift around inside the low cupboard?

trigger.detail: gaze left the fridge side and settled on the low storage

expected_answer.text: You crouched, felt along the shelf, then slid a box sideways with your left hand before closing one of the doors.

turns.text: I never went back for the fridge, did I? Is it still hanging open?

trigger.detail: the fridge left view for the rest of the kitchen

expected_answer.text: It is closed. You pushed the door shut with your right hand just after you put the purple item back on the shelf.

turns.text: Something slipped out of my grip — what happened?

trigger.detail: the dropped item was picked back up

expected_answer.text: Yes, it dropped while you were opening the second cabinet door. You retrieved it from the counter, this time with your left.

turns.text: So it's swapped hands since we started, then.

trigger.detail: the user draws the conclusion herself

expected_answer.text: Correct. It began in your right and has been in your left ever since that drop a moment ago.

turns.text: I've put it down somewhere, haven't I? Where?

trigger.detail: the climb finished and the hands are now empty

expected_answer.text: On the counter at the top of the stairs. You set it down left-handed as soon as you reached the landing.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — was anyone else up there just now?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in about something she glimpsed

expected_answer.text: Yes, there was another person by the counter. You turned left and looked at them for a couple of seconds before heading off.

turns.text: Right — that's it, I've got something. Where exactly did this turn up?

trigger.detail: the search object was lifted out and carried

expected_answer.text: In the drawer of the unit beside the closet. You opened it right-handed and lifted the soft toy out with your left.

turns.text: Something got moved out of the way in there before I found it. What was that?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in while still walking out

expected_answer.text: You crouched under the table and lifted a bin aside with your left hand, then set it down again before standing up.

turns.text: Down here, what did I look behind after shoving the bin?

trigger.detail: gaze left the storage run and acquired the doorway on entering

expected_answer.text: The potted plant on the floor. You took it in both hands, tipped it towards you and looked into the gap behind it.

turns.text: hold on — that bin, did I actually leave it sitting where it was, or not?

trigger.detail: the bin had been repositioned twice

expected_answer.text: You slid it back with one hand first, then took it in both and pulled it forward again, so it is out of place.

turns.text: I'm going to do one more sweep of the far room.

trigger.detail: the user states her next move

expected_answer.text: Understood. I will keep a note of anything you open or move in there so we can check it off afterwards.

turns.text: One more thing from before, though. That low cupboard I was crouched at — did it get shut?

trigger.detail: the user cuts back in before reaching the room

expected_answer.text: Yes. You stood up, took hold of the handle and pushed it closed with your left before moving along the run.

turns.text: Last one, then. Where did I actually get down on my knees to look?

trigger.detail: the sweep is over and the user wants a summary

expected_answer.text: Under the bed, both times. Once at the very start, and again in the upstairs room just before you found it.
